evidence.detail: KeyRemappingPlugin rs/s/j/c stores rs/s/j/b as its key listener and registers/unregisters that exact instance with the client key-listener manager during plugin startup/shutdown.
rs/s/j/b implements the client key-listener interface and owns keyTyped, keyPressed and keyReleased behavior for configured camera/F-key remapping and plugin-managed chat entry.

RuneLite source preserves the named class KeyRemappingListener with the same injected KeyRemappingPlugin/KeyRemappingConfig/Client/client-thread dependencies, modified-key map, blocked-character set and keyTyped/keyPressed/keyReleased lifecycle.

candidates.note: Corrected from the earlier descriptive KeyRemappingKeyListener label to the source-proven RuneLite class identity KeyRemappingListener.
